notes: Tier 1 = primary sources: government catalogs, research labs and incident responders publishing first-hand findings, and investigative reporters. Tier 2 = secondary reporting, advisories databases and social posts. Every vendor research lab carries the same weight so no vendor is favoured. `owner` groups feeds from the same publisher so they never count as independent corroboration. `alwaysSignal` skips the keyword filter for feeds that only publish security research.
